About us

Welcome to DESSERD by Irina! This is my cake shop and food catering service in Romford, London. We create artisan cakes, pastries, and bread - all freshly baked daily. From traditional Romanian delicacies to custom celebration cakes, we put love into every creation.

Our Specialties

  • ✦ Torturi (Custom Cakes)
  • ✦ Prăjituri (Pastries)
  • ✦ Plăcinte (Traditional Pies)
  • ✦ Sarmale & Romanian Food
  • ✦ Platouri (Food Platters)
  • ✦ Produse Congelate (Frozen Products)
